description_en: Imports an image file from Object Storage Service (OSS) as a custom cloud desktop image and returns the image ID and version ID
description_zh: 将 OSS 中的镜像文件导入为云桌面自定义镜像，返回镜像 ID 和版本 ID
name: ImportImage

parameters.help_en: The complete OSS object URL of the image file to be imported, including the bucket domain name and file path. The file must be uploaded before you call this operation. Example: https://BucketName.oss-cn-hangzhou.aliyuncs.com/FilePath
parameters.help_zh: 待导入镜像文件的完整 OSS 对象 URL，包含 Bucket 域名和文件路径。调用前应已完成文件上传，例如 https://Bucket名称.oss-cn-hangzhou.aliyuncs.com/文件路径
parameters.name: oss_object_path

parameters.help_en: The name of the image after it is imported. This parameter cannot be empty
parameters.help_zh: 导入后的镜像名称。不能为空
parameters.name: image_name

parameters.help_en: The operating system type of the image file. It must be consistent with the actual operating system of the image, such as Windows or Linux
parameters.help_zh: 镜像文件的操作系统类型，需与镜像实际操作系统一致，例如 Windows 或 Linux
parameters.name: os_type

parameters.help_en: The size of the system cloud disk. Unit: GiB
parameters.name: system_disk_size

parameters.help_en: The connection protocol of the image. Valid values: ASP and HDX. Default value: ASP
parameters.help_zh: 镜像连接协议。支持 ASP、HDX；不传时默认 ASP
parameters.name: protocol_type

parameters.help_en:
The operating system license type. Valid values:
Auto: automatically selected.
Aliyun: provided by Alibaba Cloud.
BYOL: Bring Your Own License.
Default value: Auto
parameters.help_zh: 操作系统许可证类型。Auto：自动选择；Aliyun：阿里云提供；BYOL：自带许可证。不传时默认 Auto
parameters.name: license_type

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the image is a GPU image. Valid values:
true: yes.
false: no
parameters.help_zh: 是否为 GPU 镜像。true：是；false：否
parameters.name: gpu_category

parameters.help_en:
The GPU driver type. Valid values:
gpu_grid9: GRID 9 driver.
gpu_grid12: GRID 12 driver.
gpu_custom: custom driver
parameters.help_zh: GPU 驱动类型。gpu_grid9：GRID 9 驱动；gpu_grid12：GRID 12 驱动；gpu_custom：自定义驱动
parameters.name: gpu_driver_type

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable the image security check. Valid values:
true: enables the security check.
false: disables the security check
parameters.help_zh: 是否启用镜像安全检查。true：启用；false：不启用
parameters.name: enable_security_check

parameters.help_en: The business line to which the image belongs. Default value: 1
parameters.name: biz_type

parameters.help_en: The product type. Currently, only CloudDesktop (cloud desktop) is supported
parameters.help_zh: 产品类型。当前仅支持 CloudDesktop（云桌面）
parameters.name: product_type

parameters.help_en: The business region ID. Example: cn-hangzhou
parameters.help_zh: 业务地域 ID，例如 cn-hangzhou
parameters.name: biz_region_id

parameters.help_en:
The boot mode of the image. Valid values:
BIOS: legacy BIOS boot.
UEFI: UEFI boot
parameters.help_zh: 镜像启动模式。BIOS：传统 BIOS 启动；UEFI：UEFI 启动
parameters.name: boot_mode

Code.description_en: The return code of the API. A value of 200 indicates success. If the call fails, the corresponding error code is returned
Code.description_zh: 接口返回码。200 表示成功；失败时返回对应错误码

Data.description_en: The image identifiers returned for the import request
Data.description_zh: 导入请求返回的镜像标识

ImageId.title_en: 系统镜像id有含义，自定义镜像自动生成
ImageId.title_zh: 系统镜像id有含义，自定义镜像自动生成

Message.description_en: The processing message returned by the API

RequestId.description_en: The request ID, which is used to locate and troubleshoot the request
RequestId.description_zh: 请求 ID，用于定位和排查请求

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the API call was successful. Valid values:
true: successful.
false: failed
Success.description_zh: 接口调用是否成功。true：成功；false：失败
